subject: POC outcome: latency and cost highlights + quick ask
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@fastretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:42:00-08:00
Subject: POC outcome: latency and cost highlights + quick ask

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for running the week-long POC with us. I pulled together the concise results from our telemetry and wanted to surface the numbers that your ops and product teams flagged as most meaningful. I’ve attached the dashboard export and a latency heatmap for reference.

Quick highlights (POC vs baseline):
- 42% reduction in 95th-percentile end-to-end latency (from ~820ms to ~480ms) for Live Recommendations path.
- Per-inference cost down ~31% after enabling prefix caching + INT8 quantization profile.
- Sustained throughput improved from ~220 requests/sec to ~340 requests/sec on the same instance class.
- No error-rate regressions; uptime across test windows was 99.99%.

Why this matters: lower tail latency directly reduces cart abandonment in the cart preview flow your team is optimizing, and the cost delta scales significantly at your monthly volume.

Ask: would FastRetail be willing to provide a very short public blurb (1–2 lines) we can include in a short outcomes snapshot? Example: “Redwood cut our inference latency by X and reduced our per-request bill by Y — we saw immediate impact on conversion.” We can draft the one-liner and send for your OK.

Also would you be open to a 15-minute recorded call (we can do audio-only) so we can capture a 20–30s soundbite for a case highlight? Proposed calendar: https://calendly.com/kimberly-park/15

Next steps I’ll take if you’re OK: 1) send a suggested one-liner, 2) book a 15-minute slot and record a short audio clip, 3) share a draft outcome card for approval.

Attachments: FastRetail_POC_kpi_dashboard.pdf, latency_heatmap.png

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
